_meta.checked_against: wt_r58 art/world/overworld/maps/*_hall_int.json hall_v2 grids + src/progression/hall_v2.js + puzzles.js HallV2 (T toggles bit0 -> gate b open / a shut; U toggles bit1 -> gate d open / c shut; i = slide on until floor or blocked; 1-6 = paired pads; arrows = belts). NOTE data/hall_puzzles/*.json are the older v1 puzzles (quench, tide clock, gust, sluice) and do NOT match the v2 maps.
_meta.keys: system_halls.hint_<zone>.pages = tier 1 (rule, first ask); pages_again = tier 2 (place or rule, second+ ask, never a step list). maps.<map>.<npc>.after replaces the live after line; after_old is the line being replaced.
_meta.format: pages <= 2 lines x 40 chars, joined by \n

skill_unlocks_for_coder.status: DRAFT, picks by Text Bot per Gary's ruling (put them where it makes sense in the story)

brushbreak.set_flag: has_brushbreak (already the placeholder in src/overnight/field.js BRUSH_TILES)
brushbreak.when: on sq_burlbeetle_done turn-in; add has_brushbreak to reward.flags and play teach.pages

stonebreak.when: on sq_sketch_done turn-in; add has_stonebreak to reward.flags and play teach.pages

skill_unlocks_for_coder.placement_rule: no built map has thick_brush or cracked_rock yet; place them only in optional areas reached after Thornwood (brush) / after the Greystone entrance (rock), never on the story path (FIELD_SKILLS.md: optional only)
skill_unlocks_for_coder.also: tools/merge_puzzle_hints.py SKIP_SKILLS can drop brushbreak/stonebreak now that {skill_town} is resolved; live overworld_lines.json cant_use_yet still says '{coin}'

pages:
Lost? Step out the door. The
hall sets itself back for you.
reset_note.note: shared by every hall; suggest once per hall as a door toast too (audit fix 3). Lanternport: each floor's door resets that floor (per audit, not code-checked).

pages:
Plates open gates. Step on one,
then look for what moved.
pages_again:
The plate sits up the east side
of the maze. The gate's up top.

pages:
Each floor plate swaps which
gate is open. One plate, one swap.

Watch the gates when you step.
One opens as the other shuts.
pages_again:
There's a plate in each half of
the hall. You'll want both.

pages:
Press A on a crystal to turn it.
Line the light up with the door.
pages_again:
Past the crystals, some walls
can't be seen. Only bumped.

The trainers stand on real floor.
They make good markers.

pages:
Ice slides you until something
stops you. A wall or bare floor.

Before you slide, look for what
will stop you.
pages_again:
The plate in the little maze
opens the way up to the top ice.
hint_frostspire.replaces: r58 HALL_HINTS frostspire 'Slide up the middle lane, by the pillar' (gave the answer)
hint_frostspire.note: r58 map is slide ice. The wellspire hint_frostspire (bells/vents) matches the old gust puzzle instead; pick one when the branches merge.

pages:
The two shell plates turn the
tide. Each one swaps one gate.

Glide lanes slide you until a
rock stops you. Pick your rock.
pages_again:
Both plates hide in the little
maze on the west side.

Beaten trainers step aside if
you walk into them.

pages:
Arrow plates are belts. Step on
one and it carries you along.

The belts loop, so you can't get
stuck. Just try another plate.
pages_again:
The way in is the gap on the far
right, just past the door.
pages_3:
Springs come in pairs. Step on
one, pop out at its twin.

Twins share a mark. Read the
mark before you hop.
hint_cindervale.note: pages_3 = springs (warp pads 1-3); 'share a mark' needs the paired pad glyph art from the audit V plan (hall_art already maps pad pair -> pad colour 1/2/3).

pages:
First floor: some walls hide.
Feel your way along.

Second floor: pads come in pairs.
Step on one, out at its twin.

Third floor: a plate by the
stairs works the gate up top.
pages_again:
Lost on a floor? Walk out its
door and it sets itself back.

cindervale_hall_int_h1.name: Jem
cindervale_hall_int_h1.after_old: Springs are few. Count the tiles you need before you pour.
cindervale_hall_int_h1.after:
Arrows on the floor are belts.
They carry you the way they point.

cindervale_hall_int_h2.name: Kerr
cindervale_hall_int_h2.after_old: Cooled tiles near a bellows won't stay cool. Pick a line away from them.
cindervale_hall_int_h2.after:
Belts only run one way. If one
fights you, pick another.

cindervale_hall_int_h3.name: Lark
cindervale_hall_int_h3.after_old: The lever by the door starts the floor over. Use it. Nobody counts.
cindervale_hall_int_h3.after:
Carried back down? Fine. The
belts loop. Nobody gets stuck.
cindervale_hall_int_h3.note: there is no lever in v2; the loop is the soft reset

cindervale_hall_int_h4.name: Mabry
cindervale_hall_int_h4.after_old: Brannock talks a lot before he battles. Let him. It's the only break you'll get.
cindervale_hall_int_h4.after:
Up past the belts, the springs
come in pairs. Same mark, same pair.

cindervale_hall_int_h5.name: Rasmus
cindervale_hall_int_h5.after_old:
Metal tells you when it's ready.
Listen for the ring.
cindervale_hall_int_h5.after:
Hop on a spring and you pop out
at the one with the same mark.

cindervale_hall_int_h6.name: Effie
cindervale_hall_int_h6.after_old:
Brannock respects a quick strike
while the iron's still glowing.
cindervale_hall_int_h6.after:
The way up to the springs is a
gap on the left. Belts first.

_optional_h7_h12.note: not in the audit request, but these lines are v1 too (cooling floors, bellows, pour) and now mislead

cindervale_hall_int_h7.name: Branwen
cindervale_hall_int_h7.after_old:
Hot floors cool in order.
Watch the glow fade, then step.
cindervale_hall_int_h7.after:
Step on a round plate and listen.
A gate somewhere answers you.

cindervale_hall_int_h8.name: Merrit
cindervale_hall_int_h8.after_old:
Ash settles where the air is still.
Still air, safe path.
cindervale_hall_int_h8.after:
The two plain plates share one
gate. Step twice and it shuts.

cindervale_hall_int_h9.name: Esme
cindervale_hall_int_h9.after_old:
The bellows push heat down the hall.
Ride the cool gust after.
cindervale_hall_int_h9.after:
Took a spring? Look round before
you move. Where'd you land?

cindervale_hall_int_h10.name: Clem
cindervale_hall_int_h10.after_old:
Good metal rings clear.
A dull clang means wait.
cindervale_hall_int_h10.after:
The way up is a gap in this
room's top wall.

cindervale_hall_int_h11.name: Gideon
cindervale_hall_int_h11.after_old:
Brannock tests every blade twice.
He'll test you the same.
cindervale_hall_int_h11.after:
The ice won't let go till you hit
floor or a wall. Aim first.

cindervale_hall_int_h12.name: Hesper
cindervale_hall_int_h12.after_old:
Brannock never rushes a pour.
Wait for his tell, then strike.
cindervale_hall_int_h12.after:
The odd plate in the east corner
opens the gate to the ice.

tidewater_hall_int_h1.name: Marlow
tidewater_hall_int_h1.after_old: High tide opens the glide lanes. Low tide opens the floor. Mix them.
tidewater_hall_int_h1.after:
Two shell plates, two gates.
Each plate turns just one.

tidewater_hall_int_h2.name: Moss
tidewater_hall_int_h2.after_old: Stop it at high for a lane. Stop it at low when you need the floor.
tidewater_hall_int_h2.after:
No tide clock in here. The plates
turn the tide, not the hours.

tidewater_hall_int_h3.name: Edda
tidewater_hall_int_h3.after_old: We move with the tide too. If I'm on a different ledge later, that's why.
tidewater_hall_int_h3.after:
Both plates sit at the west end
of this maze. Mind the corners.

tidewater_hall_int_h4.name: Wendell
tidewater_hall_int_h4.after_old: Jory likes the tide halfway. Not my problem anymore.
tidewater_hall_int_h4.after:
Plate shut a gate on you? Step
on it again. It turns back.

tidewater_hall_int_h5.name: Linnea
tidewater_hall_int_h5.after_old:
Every wave has a gap.
Count three, then go.
tidewater_hall_int_h5.after:
Glide lanes keep you going till
you bump a rock. Pick your rock.

tidewater_hall_int_h6.name: Fergal
tidewater_hall_int_h6.after_old:
The Master waits for the low tide.
Then moves fast.
tidewater_hall_int_h6.after:
When the tide rises, the top gate
stands open. Check before you glide.

tidewater_hall_int_h7.name: Perrin
tidewater_hall_int_h7.after_old:
Big waves come in sevens.
Rest on the small ones.
tidewater_hall_int_h7.after:
Slid wrong? Walk back down and
go again. The lanes don't mind.

tidewater_hall_int_h8.name: Senna
tidewater_hall_int_h8.after_old:
Jory's calm as still water.
That's the scary part.
tidewater_hall_int_h8.after:
Every lane ends somewhere you
can stand. Never in the sea.

helper_1.after_old: Touch a crystal and its neighbours flip too. Don't start in the middle.
helper_1.after:
There's a plate up the east side.
Stand on it, then look around.
helper_1.note: r58 v2 has no crystals; helper_2 line (crystals) is v1 too

saltmere_hall_int_h1.name: Lorna
saltmere_hall_int_h1.after_old: Watch what each wheel does to the pan next door, not just its own.
saltmere_hall_int_h1.after:
One plate, one swap. Step on it
and the two gates trade places.

saltmere_hall_int_h2.name: Ivo
saltmere_hall_int_h2.after_old: Pan went under? Turn the same wheel back. Nothing in here is stuck for good.
saltmere_hall_int_h2.after:
The other plate swaps them back.
Nothing in here sticks for good.

revival_hall_int_h2.name: Dov
revival_hall_int_h2.after_old: Beam hitting a wall? The last prism you turned is usually the problem.
revival_hall_int_h2.after:
Walls in here you can't see.
Bump one. No harm, just a nose.

revival_hall_int_h3.name: Fen
revival_hall_int_h3.after_old: Room two's easier if you start from the door and work back to the beam.
revival_hall_int_h3.after:
We all stand on real floor.
Use us as markers.

revival_hall_int_h4.name: Corwin
revival_hall_int_h4.after_old: Room three wants the beam through both crystals. One after the other.
revival_hall_int_h4.after:
Bumped nothing? Good. Bumped
something? Try the next gap.

revival_hall_int._note: h2-h4 stand in the hidden-wall maze (rows 15-23). Not checked whether they sit on the solver's path.

frostspire_hall_int_h1.name: Rue
frostspire_hall_int_h1.after_old: The feathers point the way the vents blow. Look down before you step.
frostspire_hall_int_h1.after:
Ice won't stop for you. Only a
wall or bare floor will.

frostspire_hall_int_h2.name: Bram
frostspire_hall_int_h2.after_old: One bell rope swaps every vent in the room. Think before you pull.
frostspire_hall_int_h2.after:
See the dark gaps in the ice?
That's where a slide ends.

frostspire_hall_int_h3.name: Tilly
frostspire_hall_int_h3.after_old: The eyrie's just past me. Hale's been watching since you walked in.
frostspire_hall_int_h3.after:
Slid too far? Walk round and try
again. The ice forgives.

frostspire_hall_int_h4.name: Solveig
frostspire_hall_int_h4.after_old:
The wind here always comes back.
Time your steps to it.
frostspire_hall_int_h4.after:
The plate in this maze opens the
gate up to the top ice.

frostspire_hall_int._note: r58 grid has no pillars or windbreaks; the stops are wall gaps in the ice and plain floor. h5/h6 lines (gusts) are v1 too.

lanternport_hall_int_h1.after:
Some walls here you only find
with your nose. Sorry, nose.

lanternport_hall_int_h2.after:
Hit a hidden wall? Step back and
try the next gap along.

lanternport_lighthouse_int_stairs_up.sign:
Up: second floor. Step on a pad
and it sends you to its twin.

lanternport_hall_int_h7.after:
Pads go in pairs. Learn where
each one lands and it's easy.

lanternport_hall_int_h8.after:
Landed somewhere odd? Step back
on the pad. It sends you home.

lanternport_lighthouse_f2_stairs_up.sign:
Up: third floor. A plate by the
stairs opens the gate at the top.

lanternport_hall_int_h9.after:
The plate's right by me. Step on
it and watch the gate up top.

lanternport_hall_int_h10.after:
Twisty floor, this. The plate
you want is by the stairs.

lanternport_lighthouse_f3_stairs_up.sign:
Up: the lamp room. The Master
keeps the great lens.

plate_plaque.sign:
This plate sinks under something
heavy. Step off and it rises.

hiker_b1.after:
Push it round the rocks, not
through. Leave and it rolls back.

r9_cl_field_1.after:
One plate's frozen in by the
west tarn. Mind your footing.

r9_cl_field_2.after:
Another sits south, down in the
middle tarn. Low and quiet.

r9_cl_field_3.after:
The last one's out east. Three
plates and the gate wakes up.

r9_ec_field_1.after:
Each crystal sings to the ones
beside it. Touch one, hear two.

r9_ec_field_2.after:
The middle one's awake already.
Don't wake it twice.

wall_carving.sign:
Carved here: three crystals,
all lit, side by side.

trainer_hint.after:
It worked on three in the echo
cave. Four is the same song.

reset_rule.sign:
Touch the same crystal twice
and it's as if you never had.

inspect:
A big boulder. Walk into it and
it might just shift.

cant_use_yet:
A strong Kilu could carry you,
but you need {skill}. Try Mirefen.
tideglide.source: quests.json mq_mirefen_s6: Mirefen Master teaches it (verified)

You need {skill} first. The
Frostspire Master teaches it.
skylift.source: quests.json mq_frostspire_s5 -> has_skylift (verified; live line kept, just split)

cant_use_yet:
A crystal could light this. The
Fernwick elder might know how.

You need {skill} to clear this.
Ask around Thornwood.
brushbreak.source: PICK: Thornwood bug catcher (trainer_tw_bug), turn-in of sq_burlbeetle_count 'Stumps That Blink'

pages:
Know why Burlbeetles hide as
stumps? They chew brush for fun.

Watch one go at a thicket. Snap,
snap, and there's a gap.

Your team can learn the trick.
It's called Brushbreak.

Thick brush won't stop you now,
{player}. Mind your sleeves.

cant_use_yet:
You need {skill} to break this.
Ask around Greystone.
stonebreak.source: PICK: Greystone hiker (hiker, greystone_entrance), turn-in of sq_cave_sketch 'Honest Map'

pages:
Funny thing about dead ends.
Half of them are just tired rock.

See a crack running right through?
One good hit and it gives.

The miners call it Stonebreak.
Your team can learn it too.

Boulders still want a shove,
mind. Only cracked rock breaks.
Go on. Make my map wrong again.
